demoBanner: Demonstration data: plants marked DEMO are not real.
title: Report a problem
hand: Tell us what you saw — a person will check it.
intro: Tell us about a problem at this water plant. Staff review every report. A report on its own never changes the plant's official status.
plant.heading: You are reporting on
plant.name: Name
plant.missing.title: No plant selected
plant.missing.body: Open a plant from the search results and choose “Report a problem”.
plant.notFound.title: We couldn't find that plant
plant.notFound.body: No plant has the ID {code}. It may have been removed, or the link may be wrong.
plant.error.title: Plant details could not be loaded
plant.error.body: Check your connection and try again.
how.title: How reports work
how.1: A person on our staff reads every report.
how.2: Reports alone never change a plant's official status.
how.3: Your phone number is never shown publicly.
how.4: You get a reference number to follow up.
how.appeal: Plant details wrong? Request a correction
cat.safety: If the water looks, smells or tastes wrong, don't drink it.
date.label: Date
time.label: Approximate time
when.hint: Pakistan time. It can't be in the future or more than 90 days ago.
desc.label: Description
desc.hint: What did you see? Include anything that helps staff check, like which tap or how long you waited. Don't include personal details.
photos.hint: Up to {max} photos · JPEG, PNG or WebP · up to {mb} MB each
photos.guidance: Photos are optional. Please avoid photographing people's faces, phone numbers or vehicle plates. Location data inside photos is removed automatically.
photos.err.type: “{name}” is not a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.
photos.err.count: You can add up to {max} photos.
photos.err.upload: This photo could not be uploaded.
photos.failed.title: Your photo could not be uploaded
photos.failed.body: Everything else you entered is still here. Remove the marked photo and send again, or send your report without photos.
photos.failed.tooLarge: The photos were too large to send together. Remove one and try again, or send without photos.
rating.legend: How was your experience at this plant?
rating.hint: Your rating is saved separately from your problem report. A complaint does not lower the rating automatically.
loc.toggle: Share my current location as evidence
loc.hint: Only the distance between you and the plant is kept — never your exact position. Sharing is not required.
loc.ok: Location captured. Only the distance to the plant will be saved.
loc.denied: Location permission was denied. That's fine — you can send your report without it.
loc.unavailable: Your location could not be found. You can send your report without it.
loc.unsupported: This browser can't share location. You can send your report without it.
phone.label: Phone number
phone.privacy: Your number is private. Only authorised staff can see it. It is never shown publicly.
consent.label: I agree that Team Water may use this number to verify my report or follow up with me.
verify.title: Verify your number (recommended)
verify.explain: Verifying proves you control this number; it does not decide whether a report is true.
verify.disabled: Phone verification is not available right now; staff will review your report.
verify.sent: We sent a 6-digit code to {phone}. It expires in {min} minutes.
verify.changed: You changed your number, so it needs to be verified again.
verify.err.phone: Enter a valid Pakistani phone number first.
verify.err.send: We couldn't send a code. Please try again, or send your report without verifying.
verify.err.code: That code is not correct. Check the SMS and try again.
verify.err.codeFormat: Enter the 6-digit code from the SMS.
verify.err.expired: That code has expired. Send a new code.
verify.err.attempts: Too many attempts. Please wait and send a new code later.
verify.err.cooldown: Please wait {time} before asking for another code.
slow: This is taking a while on a slow connection. Please keep this page open.
submit.note: By sending, you confirm the report is honest to the best of your knowledge.
errors.title: There is a problem
err.description.short: Describe the problem in at least {min} characters.
err.description.long: Keep the description to {max} characters or fewer.
err.date.required: Enter the date you saw the problem.
err.observed.future: The date and time can't be in the future.
err.observed.old: Reports must be about something seen in the last 90 days.
err.phone.invalid: Enter a valid Pakistani phone number, like 0300-1234567.
err.consent: Tick the box to agree that we may contact you about this report.
err.rating: Choose a rating from 1 to 5 stars, or clear it.
err.location: Your location could not be used. Turn off location sharing and try again.
err.verification: Your phone verification has expired. Verify again, or send without it.
err.generic: Something went wrong. Your details are still here — please try again.
err.network: We couldn't reach Team Water. Check your connection — your details are still here.
err.cooldown: You've sent several reports recently. Please wait {time} before sending another.
err.rejected: Your report could not be accepted. Please check your details and try again.
err.plantGone: This plant can no longer receive reports.
done.title: Thank you — your report was sent
done.copyFailed: Couldn't copy — please write it down.
done.save: Save this reference. You'll need it, and the last 4 digits of your phone number, to check your report.
done.unverified: Phone not verified — staff will still review your report.
done.rating: Your rating was recorded separately from this report.
done.ratingNot: Your rating could not be recorded this time. Your report was still sent.
done.next.title: What happens next
done.next.1: Staff review every report. You can check its status at any time.
done.next.2: Unverified reports never change a plant's official status — only a documented staff assessment can.
done.next.3: Reports that look unusual are checked by a person. They are never deleted automatically.
done.next.4: If staff need more information, the status changes to “Needs clarification” and you can reply on the status page.
status.explain.pending: We've received your report. It is waiting for a staff member to look at it.
status.explain.under_review: A staff member is checking this report.
status.explain.needs_clarification: Staff need more information from you before they can continue. Please reply below.
status.explain.confirmed: Staff checked this report and confirmed the problem.
status.explain.resolved: The problem has been marked as fixed.
status.explain.rejected: Staff could not confirm this report, or it did not follow the reporting guidelines. If you disagree, you can appeal.
st.title: Check a report
st.hand: Follow up on what you reported
st.intro: Enter your reference number and the last 4 digits of the phone number you used. We never show your full number.
st.ref.label: Reference number
st.last4.label: Last 4 digits of your phone number
st.err.last4: Enter the last 4 digits of your phone number.
st.err.notFound: We couldn't find a report with that reference and phone digits. Check both and try again.
st.err.cooldown: Too many attempts. Please wait {time} and try again.
st.appeal: Disagree with a decision? Make an appeal
reply.title: Reply to staff
reply.label: Your reply
reply.hint: Answer the staff question above. Don't include personal details.
reply.done: Thank you. Your reply was sent and staff will continue the review.
reply.err.long: Keep your reply to {max} characters or fewer.
reply.err.closed: This report is no longer waiting for a reply.
ap.title: Corrections, appeals and deletion requests
ap.intro: Tell us if plant details are wrong, if you disagree with a decision about your report, or if you want your data deleted. A person reads every request.
ap.kind.legend: What would you like to do?
ap.kind.correction.hint: A plant's name, location, hours or other details are wrong.
ap.kind.appeal.hint: You disagree with how staff handled your report.
ap.kind.deletion_request.hint: We erase your phone number and redact the text and photos of your reports.
ap.ref.label: Report reference (optional)
ap.ref.hint: If this is about a report, enter its reference, like TW-XXXX-XXXX.
ap.plant.label: Plant ID
ap.plant.hint: For example FSD-WFP-0123. It's shown on the plant's card.
ap.phone.label: Your phone number
ap.phone.hint: Use the number you reported with, so we can match your request. Format: 03XX-XXXXXXX
ap.message.label: Message
ap.message.hint.correction: What is wrong, and what is correct? Tell us how you know.
ap.message.hint.appeal: Why do you disagree with the decision?
ap.message.hint.deletion_request: Anything that helps us find your data. Staff will confirm before deleting.
ap.done.title: Your request was received
ap.done.body: Keep this reference. A staff member will review your request and may contact you on the number you gave.
ap.err.kind: Choose what you'd like to do.
ap.err.ref: Check the reference — it looks like TW-XXXX-XXXX.
ap.err.plant: Enter the plant ID, like FSD-WFP-0123.
ap.err.message.long: Keep your message to {max} characters or fewer.
ap.err.notFound: We couldn't match that report or plant. Check the reference and plant ID.
ap.err.cooldown: Too many requests. Please wait {time} and try again.
hp.label: Leave this field empty
